name: Daybreak
description: Warm paper surface, near-black ink, one deep teal accent. Same families, roles, layouts, and presets as Dusk: a deck moves between them by swapping the file.

title.description: Opening or section title, and the place for a shader backdrop such as `backdrop`. Dusk's kicker runs in the bottom corner of every layout.

subtitle.prompt: What it's about, in a line

statement.description: One sentence, set large, and what supports it.

poster.description: A statement beside its art: a section's hinge or the close.

full.description: One thing, full bleed to the grid.

main.prompt: A picture, a chart, or a table

note.prompt: A note on it, or its source

figure.description: A headline, the figure that shows it, and a note on it, each in its own rows. Data reads on the plain surface: no shader behind it (W311).

note.prompt: Its source, or a note on it

narrow-figure.description: As `figure`, for a figure of two or three bars, with its note beside it.
